relations.title: Tiempo del hecho y del conocimiento
Phylons relabeling cascades
relations.reading: Event time and knowledge time should remain distinct when reconstructing an audit decision.

relations.title: Annex 7 — Reference Architecture and Implementation
relations.reading: The supplier case shows why evidence handoff needs the decision context that makes a document meaningful.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Reusable audit evidence provides a concrete setting for distinguishing avoidable reconstruction from necessary assurance, while measuring the net work of maintaining the shared evidence model.

relations.title: Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: Evidence reuse across audits should carry purpose, scope, version and access conditions, so a reusable record does not become an unrestricted or context-free assertion.

relations.title: Annex 01J — Ecosystem Signalling: Selective Disclosure, Distributed Opportunity and Choreographed Repositioning
relations.reading: Selective, source-qualified handoffs could let one field fact support several receivers without exposing unnecessary information or substituting one receiver’s determination for another’s.
